title: Shared definitions for the JP4WC security check contract

schema_version.description: Format version of the contract. Bumped only for an incompatible change, which is then served under a new URL (/feed/v2/).

timestamp.description: UTC time in ISO 8601 with a Z suffix and no fractional seconds.

feed_version.description: Opaque identifier of one generated feed. Changes whenever any feed file changes.

slug.description: Plugin or theme slug as WordPress and Wordfence use it (the core slug is "wordpress").

attribution.description: Credit line the client shows wherever it displays the data, e.g. in the admin footer.

copyrights.description: Copyright holders of the vulnerability data, copied from the Wordfence Intelligence V3 copyrights object (without its message key).

check_id.description: Local check ID: V (vulnerabilities), A (admin access), D (data exposure) or M (malware), then two digits.
